title: Building a Professor Layton retrospective with AI-assisted artwork
author: BRIDMARYGOKU1
selftext:
Hi everyone! I'm building a gaming retrospective YouTube series called The Geeky Gamer UK, starting with Professor Layton.

I'm making the videos on my phone using free tools, recording my own narration and learning the editing process as I go. I'm also using AI-assisted illustrations where I don't have suitable gameplay footage.

I'm researching the games and checking the information rather than simply accepting whatever AI tells me. My aim is to create a proper gaming documentary about the characters, stories and history behind the series.

I'm still learning, so I'd be interested in hearing from other creators who use AI as part of their workflow. What have you found works best for combining AI-generated visuals with your own storytelling?
